default.source: PLACEHOLDER - open decision in docs/plan.md section 13; 12 h for every fuel, enough to carry a fire through one night
default.note: team assumption, not a measurement; in the sensitivity analysis (WP 3.2)

fuel_model.source: PLACEHOLDER - team assumption (docs/plan.md sections 2.6 and 13): TL3, moderate load conifer litter, as the surrogate fuel of an urban cell
fuel_model.note: written into urban cells by the data generators; a slow-burning timber litter model

ros_factor.source: PLACEHOLDER - team assumption (docs/plan.md sections 2.6 and 13): fire takes twice as long to cross into and through an urban cell as through the surrogate fuel
ros_factor.note: in [0, 1]; multiplies the urban cell's rate of spread in every direction, after the spread rule

residence_factor.source: PLACEHOLDER - team assumption (docs/plan.md sections 2.6 and 13): an urban cell flames 30 times as long as the surrogate fuel (TL3 residence time 15.0 s, Anderson 1969, -> 7.5 min; it was 1 h while the TL3 value was a 120 s placeholder)
residence_factor.note: >= 1; multiplies the residence time of the urban cell's fuel model
